newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: UN Iraq Sec Council meet delayed as members confer.
newsitem.headline: UN Iraq Sec Council meet delayed as members confer.

text.p: The United Nations Security Council meeting to discuss a resolution on the Iraq crisis will be delayed for an hour until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT to allow members to discuss the issue informally, diplomats said Thursday.

United States diplomats were meeting with counterparts from other permanent members to discuss a compromise as Russia held firm against a British draft resolution which strongly condemned Iraq for its incursion into protected Kurdish zones last weekend, the diplomats said.
Earlier Thursday, Russia's U.N. envoy, Sergey Lavrov, told Reuters that his country remained opposed to the British wording.
